proposals.before: Yelü Chun — his age is known as Northern Liao.
proposals.after: Yelü Chun — his regime is known as Northern Liao.
proposals.reason: 世號 means the age/world designated his polity as Northern Liao, not that his lifespan is so called.

proposals.before: Yelü Dashi — his age is known as Western Liao (Qara-Khitai).
proposals.after: Yelü Dashi — his regime is known as Western Liao (Qara-Khitai).
proposals.reason: Same 世號 pattern as Northern Liao: designates the polity/regime, not a lifespan label.

proposals.before: Chancellor Li Chuwen and others secretly admitted Song troops; residents responded from within, and gate guards were killed in great numbers.
proposals.after: Chancellor Li Chun and others secretly admitted Song troops; residents responded from within, and gate guards were killed in great numbers.
proposals.reason: Chinese 李純 is Li Chun; Chuwen invents syllables not in the name.

proposals.before: At age seven he wished to establish him as heir apparent, separately set up inner guard, and enfeoffed him Prince of Liang.
proposals.after: At age seven, [the court] wished to establish him as heir apparent, separately set up inner guard, and enfeoffed him Prince of Liang.
proposals.reason: 欲立為皇太子 has impersonal/court subject; literal wrongly makes Yali the one wishing.

decisions.reason: 世號為北遼 names the polity by which the age knew Yelü Chun, not his lifespan; “regime” correctly replaces the false “age” reading while keeping the rest of the sentence.
Parallel 世號為西遼 likewise designates the Western Liao polity, not a lifespan label; “regime” fixes the same mistranslation of 世號.
宰相李純 is Li Chun; “Chuwen” invents syllables absent from 李純. The proposed name matches the Chinese and the already-extracted personal-name claim.
七歲，欲立為皇太子 has no subject that is Yali; the wishing is impersonal/court action. Supplying [the court] corrects the false agent without altering the rest of the literal wording.
